DATE_BEFORE_MIN.description: `eventDate` should be later than the set minimum date (year 0)

DATE_IN_FUTURE.description: `eventDate` should not be in the future

LON_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: `decimalLongitude` should be within the range of -180 to 180

LAT_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: `decimalLatitude` should be within the range of -90 to 90

DEPTH_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: `minimumDepthInMeters` and `maximumDepthInMeters` should be within the range of -100000 and 11000

DEPTH_EXCEEDS_BATH.description: `minimumDepthInMeters` and `maximumDepthInMeters` should be less than or equal to the bathymetric depth

ON_LAND.description: The occurrence is located on land, based on OpenStreetMap land polygons

NO_MATCH.description: Taxon should unambiguously match with WoRMS

NOT_MARINE.description: Taxon should not be exclusively freshwater or terrestrial according to WoRMS

NO_ACCEPTED_NAME.description: An accepted name should exist in WoRMS

MARINE_UNSURE.description: Taxon should not be exclusively freshwater or terrestrial according to WoRMS

WORMS_ANNOTATION_NO_BIOTA.description: When OBIS receives a scientific name which cannot be matched with WoRMS automatically, it is sent to the WoRMS team. The WoRMS team will then annotate the name to indicate if and how the name can be fixed.
